graph.title: Controlling the AD5206 Digital Potentiometer with SPI (6 LED dimming)
notes: The AD5206 is not in the catalogue, so it is a new part type 'ad5206' whose ports are the datasheet pin names (A1..A6, W1..W6, B1..B6, GND, CS, VDD, SDI, CLK, VSS). Each channel is modelled as through A-W and W-B.

The circuit image was not available, so breadboard hole positions are my own layout: the chip straddles the centre gap, pins 1-12 in row e of columns 10-21 (top bank), pins 13-24 in row f of columns 21-10 (bottom bank).
Per the code comments: all A pins and VDD go to +5V; all B pins, GND and VSS go to ground (VSS is 0 V for single-supply operation); CS to Uno pin 10, SDI to pin 11 (MOSI), CLK to pin 13 (SCK).
Each W pin goes through a 220 ohm resistor and then an LED (anode to resistor, cathode to ground). A short jumper carries each wiper to a free breadboard column that holds the resistor.
The top and bottom power rails are separate strips on the breadboard, so they are bridged with jumpers (wire3, wire4). The Uno 5V and GND.1 pins feed the top rails.
The LED on channel n is led n (W n); the code addresses channels 0-5, with addresses 000 for W1 through 101 for W6 per the datasheet.
